title: vandellia anagallis
intro: Vandellia anagallis, commonly known as "Vandellia", is a medicinal plant native to tropical regions. It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, with health benefits including its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat skin conditions such as eczema and boils. The therapeutic actions of Vandellia include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which help to soothe and heal wounds. The bioactive constituents of Vandellia include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
